_comment: Issue #22 [Invisibility] canonical -- the Mage-kit mirror of stealth_loop's sneak-past-the-ambush pattern, PLUS the ruling's two-verbs-one-stance proof. Loads near_mage_invisibility (mage L5 + rogue L1, both fixture-set directly, floodplains at (30,16) facing down, six open steps north of goblin_encounter_1). Field-hotbar order: 1 [Basic Cleaning], 2 [Light], 3 [Invisibility], 4 [Stealth]. Toggles [Invisibility] ON (hotbar_3) -- proves its OWN distinct render (deeper alpha 0.35 + shimmer:true on ui_sneak_rendered, vs [Stealth]'s plain 0.6/no-shimmer default) -- walks the REAL goblin_encounter_1 Chebyshev-2 zone with zero combat_started (the skip). Then, DELIBERATELY using the OTHER sneaks-tagged skill, [Stealth] (hotbar_4), to turn sneaking back OFF: a sneak_ended (not a fresh sneak_started) fires, proving both verbs flip the SAME single `sneaking` bool rather than stacking or nesting -- live through real input, not just the unit-test synthetic-tag proof. The positive control mirrors stealth_loop exactly: same cell, now not sneaking, the very next move fires the ambush for real. Ends right after combat_started (mid-combat by design, the stealth_loop/combat_move_input precedent) -- no fight is resolved. Fixture rng_state is cosmetic, seed 9 for convention.

steps._comment: 4 field slots: basic_cleaning, light, invisibility, sneak (known_skills order: player_skills, then mage's L1-L5 grants in level order, then rogue's L1 grant) -- [Invisibility] and [Stealth] both present and correctly carded. THE COMBAT MECHANIC LINE IS GONE FROM THIS READOUT ON PURPOSE (v0.16.1 finding 1): the exploration hotbar used to compose through the COMBAT composer, so these two dual-context Skills advertised '1 AP, 3 MP — become impossible to target for 3 rounds' and '1 AP — +2 move cells this turn' out on the map, where nothing is spent and no round clock runs. The field readout now goes through WIEffectText.field_effect_lines, which is silent for combat-only phrasing, so each slot falls back to display_name — description. The combat HUD and the journal keep the cost-bearing line (pinned in test_effect_text's EXPECTED_SKILLS); the field variant is pinned in EXPECTED_FIELD_SKILLS. The FIELD behavior this whole script proves (sneaking toggle, ambush skip, shared-flag coexistence) is completely untouched.

readout_lines: 1  [Basic Cleaning] — Cleans mundane messes with supernatural ease.
2  [Light] — A mage's first, faithful spell: a small orb of steady white light.
3  [Invisibility] — A working that bends the light around you until even a careful eye finds nothing worth watching.
4  [Stealth] — A soft step that slips past watching eyes and clears ground when blades are drawn.

steps._comment: Toggle [Invisibility] ON (slot 3). Distinct render: alpha 0.35 + shimmer true, vs [Stealth]'s plain 0.6/no-shimmer default -- the DATA-driven sneak_visual hook, proven live.
steps.name: hotbar_3

steps._comment: Walk the REAL Chebyshev-2 zone around goblin_encounter_1 (30,23), same route stealth_loop proves for [Stealth].

Break sneak with the OTHER tagged skill, [Stealth] (slot 4) -- NOT the skill that turned it on. A DIFFERENT id carrying sneaks:true still flips the SAME shared flag: sneak_ended (not sneak_started) fires, the off-toast is the SAME shared line, proving one stance/two keys live (issue #22 ruling), not the [Invisibility]-only unit-test coverage.
steps.name: hotbar_4

steps._comment: POSITIVE CONTROL, same run: still standing at (30,22) inside the SAME Chebyshev-2 zone, now NOT sneaking -- the very next move fires the ambush for real, proving the earlier skip was `sneaking` itself.
